summary: Phase 3 (Calls signaling + Call AI Intelligence + privacy + calendar) tested end-to-end plus Phase 1/2 regression. Backend: 28 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_calls.py — call lifecycle (start voice/video, accept, reject, end, ringing->missed, get, history newest-first with peer/direction/has_transcript), authorization (401 without bearer on GET/POST /calls*, 404 for foreign chat_id, 404 for non-participant), AI intelligence via transcript-text (get transcript, summary with full schema keys summary/key_points/decisions/action_items/deadlines/follow_ups/questions, tasks items with type/title/owner/when, ask with answer+source, delete transcript, search matches), privacy defaults (call_intelligence/call_transcription/call_summary/call_memory all true), privacy gate flips POST /calls/{id}/ai to 403 and re-enable restores 200, calendar POST/GET, and Phase 1/2 regression (login, chats, send message, smart-reply, chat-brain summary, ai/chat, user search, contacts/list>=3). 28/28 passed = 100% (two AI cases hit transient Cloudflare 502 on first run when LLM took >100s; passed cleanly on rerun). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): Calls tab shows history rows call-<call_id> with type icon (voice/video), missed vs duration (e.g., '1 min'), timestamp, and AI sparkles when has_transcript is true. Chat header of Rahul DM has voice-call-button, video-call-button, chat-brain-button. Tapping voice-call-button opens the outgoing call overlay with 'Calling…' + Rahul avatar/name and an End button; ending returns to chat. Privacy screen shows Call Intelligence / Call Transcription / Call Summary toggles (+ general Calls, Memory). Call Intelligence screen (/call-intelligence/[id]) renders Transcript block, Summary button (gen-summary), Action Items (gen-tasks), delete-transcript, and call-ask-input + call-ask-submit; call-notes-input + save-notes testIDs exist when no transcript. No red screen, no deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: LLM (summary/tasks) can take 60-100s+ under load; the Cloudflare edge returned 502 on 2/28 requests in one run but the same call succeeded on retry. Consider a shorter model timeout + graceful retry on the server, or streaming.

ui_bugs.issue: Review request specified testID='end-call-button' but the rendered testID is 'end-call'. Functionally correct — cosmetic inconsistency only.

issues: Backend privacy has a distinct key `call_memory` (default true) but the Privacy UI does not surface a dedicated 'Call Memory' toggle — only a general 'Memory' toggle plus 'Calls' toggle. If call_memory is meant to be independently controllable per the spec, add a switch-call_memory row.

action_items: (LOW) Rename end-call testID -> end-call-button, or update spec docs; either is fine but aligning would reduce future automation churn.
(LOW) Consider adding an explicit 'Call Memory' switch on Privacy screen matching the backend `call_memory` privacy key so users can toggle it independently.
(OPTIONAL) Add server-side retry/backoff on ai_json for /calls/{id}/ai to avoid transient 502s when LLM latency exceeds Cloudflare's timeout.
critical_code_review_comments: calls_routes.py._call_for correctly filters by participants, so a non-participant reading /api/calls/{id} obscures existence with 404 — good.
calls_routes.py.start_call broadcasts an 'incoming_call' event via ws_manager.send_to_user to each callee (excluding caller) — matches spec.
calls_routes.py.end_call correctly computes duration from connected_at only, and marks ringing->missed if never connected — matches spec.
call_ai gates by privacy.call_intelligence (403), further gates 'summary' by privacy.call_summary. transcript upload gates by call_transcription. Consistent with privacy toggles.
call_ai enforces 'no transcript => 400' before calling LLM — avoids wasted tokens/hallucination — good.
ai_json prompt embeds transcript verbatim and instructs the model to never invent info + cite the call — good hallucination guard.
calls_routes.py properly excludes MongoDB _id in every read (find_one/find with projection {_id:0}) — good.
calls_routes.py.search_calls only searches calls where participant matches, so cross-tenant leaks are impossible.

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 Phase-3 tests including regression subset). 2 tests briefly failed with Cloudflare 502 on first run due to LLM latency; both passed on retry.
success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase-3 UI surfaces verified: Calls tab with type/missed/duration/sparkles, chat header voice/video/brain call buttons, outgoing call overlay + End, Privacy call toggles (Intelligence/Transcription/Summary), Call Intelligence screen (transcript, summary, tasks, ask, delete).

seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST calls in the demo account (voice + video, various statuses) and one call with transcript ('Alice: ... Rahul: budget 50k ...') used by the CI screen verification (call_65597a14c5194dc3). Also created TEST_Meeting_* calendar events. All items are demo-account-scoped and prefixed TEST_ where user-visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo@chatly.app / Demo1234. BASE URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Phase-3 pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_calls.py (~2m30s incl. LLM calls, 28/28). Real WebRTC media (audio/video streams) NOT testable in Expo web — only signaling + REST are covered. Media transcription via /api/calls/{id}/transcript (multipart audio) is available but was tested through /transcript-text which is the deterministic path. If retesting call AI, allow generous timeouts (60-120s) — Cloudflare may 502 the first hit if LLM is slow. Frontend testIDs: login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button, calls tab rows call-<call_id> and callback-<call_id>, chat header voice-call-button/video-call-button/chat-brain-button, overlay end-call (not end-call-button), CI screen gen-summary/gen-tasks/delete-transcript/call-ask-input/call-ask-submit/call-notes-input/save-notes, privacy switch-call_intelligence/switch-call_transcription/switch-call_summary/switch-calls.
